root_cause.primary: validate_corpus.py::cache calls canonical(decode(value),schema); canonical INTEGER returns int(value), so compact JSON emits unquoted 0.
root_cause.independent: independent_contamination.py::evidence uses canon for both raw freshness and atom values; canon INTEGER returns str(int(x)), so compact JSON emits quoted "0".
root_cause.additional_definite_shape_issue: Both existing paths put semantic tags (DATE/INTEGER/etc.) in freshness rows rather than the declared schema_type bytes (YYYY-MM-DD/integer/etc.). No implementation was changed because the scalar serialization question remains unresolved.
root_cause.number_current_paths: Both format NUMBER as exact decimal text; agreement alone cannot establish that JSON text storage is the frozen freshness representation.
